current_semantics_replacement_map.replacement: policy.dispatch -> original _run_single_tool hook under original trace call and exact lease; NodeExecutor remains the low-level retry owner

policy_method_contracts.__init__/snapshot/restore: Snapshot contains version1/protocol, ordered registry entries and action entries, original serialized PlanGraph, portable StateSchema tokens, max_retries, limits and hook_profile. No callables, credentials, live clients or authorization context in policy snapshot. Runtime context remains under the existing protected run owner.
policy_method_contracts.validate_saved: Verify kernel=workflow_agentic, immutable snapshot/catalog/plan/schema/hook profile, current actor/Mod and exact durable model reference. Bind saved state for reconstruction. Any drift blocks the original run; no automatic policy substitution.
policy_method_contracts.request(messages,state): Reconstruct original agent_history in decision order from saved assistant envelopes and validated delivered receipts; use last8 builder; produce exact original JSON-only prompt, not an SDK tool catalog prompt.
policy_method_contracts.transport(request): Call the existing late-bound engine._llm_decide_next_step under a context-local bound model transport. Default AgentDecisionClient uses the captured client/model and common model_transport once; raw HTTP compatibility API remains standalone single-decision only. Normalize complete decisions, never partial text.
policy_method_contracts.prepare_arguments: Use strict parse_arguments for canonical wrapper JSON; no malformed/non-object/duplicate-field conversion to empty object.
policy_method_contracts.validate_call: Verify one-step policy/catalog/current canonical spec, action params, actor/Mod/RBAC and restorable write profile before dispatch. Existing AgentToolExecutor, approval grant and write ledger remain final authority.
policy_method_contracts.dispatch: Use the new WorkflowAgenticExecutionLease capability on the admitted original run. RunTraceService.dispatch_tool resolves existing ERP wrapper to real tool/action/params; callback calls the original _run_single_tool with dynamic trusted context. Trusted metrics callback commits exact result projection with original receipt.
policy_method_contracts.observe: Validate call identity/output digest/projection metadata. Reconstruct public node results and final_context; live callbacks only for newly observed transitions, not replayed historical transitions. On approved continuation derive a new projection revision from actual StepExecution fields on the same call; unrelated digest changes fail.
policy_method_contracts.no_call_transition: Optional shared-driver hook with strict result schema and zero calls only: continue -> ready_model; done -> terminal success/failure; none -> terminal failure. Only phase/outcome/final_text/exit_status changes allowed. Cannot change limits, request_id, batch/cursor, references or identity. Existing policies keep old default no-call behavior.
policy_method_contracts.result: Return JSON-safe serialized WorkflowRunResult under result_key=workflow_result; outer WorkflowEngine reconstructs dataclass and service formats actual AgentRun. No static PlanGraph execution and no second scheduler.

canonical_json_batch_identity.decision_envelope: Persist assistant.content as exact_json({kind: execute|done|invalid|none, decision: normalized_original_decision}); batch contains zero or one call. The internal JSON reasoning is never emitted as streamed user text.
canonical_json_batch_identity.call_id_formula: wfa_ + canonical_hash([run_id, persisted request_id, 0, tool_id, normalized_action, exact_business_params])[:48]. The single-entry index is0. Persist before any intent; resume uses saved ID without recalculation/new provider request.
canonical_json_batch_identity.deduplication: Do not dedupe by params: two legitimate later decisions with identical params have distinct persisted request_id/call_id. Admission dedup is by original task/turn fingerprint; original repeated call ID cannot bind different params.
canonical_json_batch_identity.empty_decisions: done/none/invalid have no synthetic tool, no ToolCall placeholders and no business intent. Invalid hook decisions retain the old assistant+System invalid-decision history and count toward10; final done cannot erase decision_errors.
canonical_json_batch_identity.strict_difference: The old direct parser params-not-object -> {} behavior is unsafe for governed execution and has no equivalent safe mapping. Standalone single-decision compatibility can remain for API stability; the new governed policy rejects before intent. Explicit tests and authorization of this safety correction are required.

run_admission_and_execution.server_scope: Reuse existing claim_first_task_run and scope [tenant,user,actor.mod_id,conversation,turn/task hint]. Preserve supplied authoritative original task identity; never create a new ID merely to escape an existing run. Include plan+ordered catalog+portable schema/options in workflow request fingerprint.
run_admission_and_execution.implementation: TraceRunService adds/factors claim_model_turn internally with defaults preserving legacy admission hashes. workflow_agentic calls require actual actor scope, execution_kernel and WorkflowAgenticExecutionLease; existing LegacyExecutionLease remains unchanged for legacy.
run_admission_and_execution.canonical_task: Apply task_context, root_run_id=original run, plan_id/intent/source and runtime scope before the first model. Existing same fingerprint returns that same run; different content/scope conflicts. A runtime/server capability cannot be constructed from JSON.
run_admission_and_execution.lease: run_model_turn obtains existing exact-run SQL queue claim/heartbeat/fencing via model_turn_lease_scope; worker resume reuses ClaimedRunRepository, never claims another task. No SQL schema or worker/approval implementation changes proposed.
run_admission_and_execution.budget: rounds10, calls at most10/stricter server cap, repeat0 matching the old loop, active seconds300 or stricter existing server deadline. Approval waiting time excluded; the active counter persists and is checked before model and every tool.
run_admission_and_execution.approval: Actual pending receipt stops the cursor. GET original run issues its existing bound grant; POST continue uses original run/step/call/params and queue claim. resume_model_turn restores new policy and execute_approved reuses StepExecution and original usage identity. No grant refresh, replan or new task.
run_admission_and_execution.safety_behavior_change: The old loop continued asking the model after an unresolved tool failure. The migration must stop on unknown/pending/waiting_approval rather than reproduce unsafe continuation; this explicit safety correction is required by the shared kernel and must be validated, not hidden as exact behavior parity.

projection_contract.authorities: Original ToolCall.output and business verification stay authoritative. Serialized workflow projection is secondary and digest-bound to call_id/output; never use it as authorization or completion evidence.
projection_contract.atomic_metrics: receipt_metadata() returns only serializable NodeExecutionResult fields; trace_runs stores them with receipt/output digest in the same fenced save. If metrics serialization fails, commit actual safe receipt plus projection_error and suspend without another side effect.
projection_contract.approved_revision: If and only if the same original call changed from waiting_approval through proven formal StepExecution, reconstruct updated metrics from that actual step/call/attempt and persist a new projection revision. A changed digest without this exact transition is corruption.
projection_contract.public_shape: Keep WorkflowRunResult(plan_id,success,node_results,final_context,message). Keep public node_results.node_id aliases returned by original hooks and final_context.node_outputs agent_step_N keys. Canonical durable step/node/call IDs use unique original call ID; do not overwrite them with duplicate display aliases.
projection_contract.state: Preserve existing append/merge/output/emit order inline, StateEvents callback scopes, max_retries, agentic-vs-DAG params, schema errors and summary text. Reconstruct final_context from original context + validated projection records in model decision order.
projection_contract.waiting_status: New actual wait/unknown states project success=False and truthful workflow_status waiting_user/blocked/pending; do not call them completed or run.failed solely because an approval is pending. This is an explicit safety repair of the old observed workflow result.
projection_contract.events: Actual tool/approval/model events are written once by canonical owners; state.update publication occurs for new live projection transitions only. On reconnect/replay use durable events and cursors. Do not append old observed tool.started/completed copies.
projection_contract.callback_limits: Arbitrary Python callbacks have no durable acknowledgment protocol, so exactly-once callback invocation across an OS crash cannot be promised. Preserve inline order/isolation; never replay historical arbitrary callbacks automatically after restart. Durable event records remain the recoverable authority.
projection_contract.cost: Keep provider billing at its existing owner and do not add a second charge in policy.meter. Preserve displayed tool cost_units/permission/tool count/artifact count from actual original calls. Approval continuation must retain the call/billing ID and charge once.
